import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { film } from "./film";

export const actor = defineTable("actor", {
    columns: {
        actorId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        firstName: col.text().notNull(),
        lastName: col.text().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        film: rel.manyToMany(() => film, {
            through: "film_actor",
            pivot: {
                lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
            }
        })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
